problem: The professor of geometry notices that, on average, every batch of practice questions contains $6$ questions that cite the interior angle theorem in the solution. What is the probability that in the next batch of practice questions, there will be more than $5$ questions that cite the interior angle theorem in the solution? Round your answer to $3$ decimal places. You may assume that questions that cite the interior angle theorem in the solution occur independently and at a constant average rate.
